meta.scene: 11:58 p.m. The elevator dings at an empty floor.
Mop. Bucket. A bass line from the radio on the cart.
His foot starts tapping on its own.
The mop becomes a dance partner.
Floor 23: he moonwalks past the CEO’s office.
The motion-sensor lights start keeping time.
Every floor lights up as he spins past.
Breakdown: just him, the slap bass, and the city lights.
Security watches on camera. Security is also dancing.
